patterns: How do I connect to the university Wi‑Fi?
Where is the Wi‑Fi login page?
responses: The university Wi‑Fi password is kiukiu2020.
You can connect to the KIU network using password: kiukiu2020.

patterns: Can you tell me the library location?
I need to go to the library
How do I get to the library?
responses: The library is located on the 1st floor of Building K.
Head to Building K, first floor — that’s where the library is!

patterns: How do I register for courses?
Where do I enroll in my subjects?
Help me sign up for classes
I want to register for next semester
responses: Go to your student portal > Academics > Course Registration.
You can register under 'Course Registration' in your portal account.

patterns: Do I need CS101 before taking CS102?
What are the prerequisites for CS102?
Is CS101 required for the next course?
Do I need any class before CS102?
Tell me if CS101 is a prerequisite
responses: Yes, CS101 is a required prerequisite for CS102.
You must complete CS101 before enrolling in CS102.

patterns: Where can I find my exam schedule?
responses: Your exam schedule is available in the 'Exams' tab in your student portal.
Log in to your portal and go to 'Exams' to view your schedule.

patterns: How do I request dorm maintenance?
My dorm light is broken, what do I do?
Who do I call for dorm problems?
responses: You can request dorm maintenance through the Dorm Management section of your portal.
Report issues to the dorm staff or submit a request online via Dorm Services.

patterns: Until when can I apply for 2025?
responses: International students can apply for 2025–2026 until **August 15, 2025**. 🗓️
The application deadline for the next academic year is **August 15, 2025**. Please apply before then.

You need at least B1-level English via TOEFL, IELTS, Versant, or Duolingo English Test. Contact apply@kiu.edu.ge if unsure.

patterns: Do I have to do an interview?
Tell me about the admission interview
responses: All undergrad applicants must pass an **online interview in English** as part of the admission process.
Yes – there’s an English online interview, required before the university issues the consent letter.

Expect ≈ $6 000/year tuition and ≈ $3 000/year dorm fee for most programs.
Current undergrad English programs: Management, Mathematics, Computer Science.
KIU offers BSc in Management, Mathematics, and Computer Science (with more programs launching soon).
Yes, there are merit-, need‑based, government & international scholarships available.

patterns: Tell me about dorms and labs
responses: Campus has full‑furnished dorms, modern labs, cafeterias, library, and co‑working spaces.
You’ll find state‑of‑the‑art labs, cafeterias, library, co‑working areas—and student housing is fully furnished.
